birth_timezone.description: Birth timezone (IANA name or UTC offset). Optional: when omitted, FateBridge infers it from birth_place (same as the BaZi/ZiWei engines) and only falls back to UTC if no place is recognized. The default is None — never 'UTC' — because a truthy 'UTC' default silently treats an eastern wall-clock time as UTC and rotates the whole chart; every subclass (chart / relative / timing / lifespan) therefore inherits the safe place-inference behavior automatically.

return_timezone.description: Return chart timezone (IANA name or UTC offset)

house_system.description: House system, any convention: SE letter ('P'=Placidus, 'R'=Regiomontanus, 'W'=whole sign, 'D'=equal_mc), key ('placidus', 'equal_mc'), or integer code 0..8 (3=Placidus, 8=equal_mc).

zodiac_type.description: Zodiac type, e.g. Tropic or Sidereal

pd_method.description: Primary direction method identifier, e.g. astroapp_alchabitius, legacy_reference / legacy_equatorial, or fatebridge_mundane_semiarc

pd_time_key.description: Primary direction time key, e.g. Ptolemy or Naibod

pd_type.description: Primary direction mode: 0 for direct, 1 for converse

show_pd_bounds.description: Whether to expose the bounds overlay preference for the primary direction chart

selected_sections.description: Optional export sections to keep in snapshot_export

compact.description: 紧凑 JSON 输出（无缩进）；设为 false 则美化缩进。默认 true。

include_snapshot_text.description: 是否包含人类可读的 snapshot_text 文本段（默认随工具而定）；设为 false 可显著减少返回的 token 数。

fields.description: 仅返回选定字段以节省 token：接受顶层键（如 'snapshot_text'）或点路径子字段（如 'bazi_birth.day_master'）。run_metadata 始终保留；留空返回全部字段。
